title: The same two means, vertical axis starting at zero
alt: The same two bars, 137.5 and 146.5 mg/dL, on an axis starting at zero, where the two heights look nearly the same.
longDescription: The bars carry the same two numbers as the previous chart: 137.5 mg/dL for the earlier-dinner group and 146.5 mg/dL for the later-dinner group, a difference of 9.0 mg/dL. Here the vertical axis starts at zero, so each bar's height is proportional to the mean it represents. The later bar is about 6.5 percent taller than the earlier one, which is close to the edge of what an eye reliably picks out. Neither chart is wrong about the numbers; the two pictures disagree about how large 9.0 mg/dL looks, and the axis choice is what changed.
